sources.title: GitHub - openai/CLIP: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining ...
sources.snippet: CLIP [Blog] [Paper] [Model Card] [Colab] CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training) is a neural network trained on a variety of (image, text) pairs. It can be instructed in natural language to predict the most relevant text snippet, given an image, without directly optimizing for the task, similarly to the zero-shot capabilities of GPT-2 and 3.

sources.title: Learning protein language contrastive models with multi-knowledge ...
sources.snippet: Recently, contrastive learning has been demonstrated to model the complementarity and inconsistencies between multi-knowledge or multi-view domains in computer vision (CV) and graph neural networks [15]. Multi-knowledge contrastive learning methods have achieved state-of-the-art results in knowledge tracking and recommender systems [16].
